about_the_game:
Demo Information

This is the demo for the unreleased game Hoard Defender VR! It will be available a limited time, up until a week after Next Fest June 2025, June 23rd 2025, so play while you can!

The demo has limited upgrades compared to the base game, with the list of abilities below. Try to get flame breath for an extra challenge! It also has a limited number of waves compared to the full game, including waves up to wave 10. Additionally, the currency Vigor is removed in the demo, so you only have Gold to play around with.

Description

Hoard Defender VR is a virtual reality game where you play as a dragon. Everything was relatively normal for you, burning villages and collecting treasure, until the local king had the idea to try and take your hoard! Now he's sending waves of his army, composed of everything from peasants to wizards, to try and steal your hard earned gold! Luckily, they brought some of their own gold so you may just make it out of this with more gold than you started with. You just hope enough isn't taken to reveal the greatest treasure hiding underneath the gold, your dragon rubies...

Buy upgrades to get stronger!

Buy all kinds of upgrades to defend your hoard from the oncoming enemies using gold! Get upgrades such as:

  • Devour, to eat enemies whole!

  • Flame Breath, to burn the entire track to a crisp!

  • Walls, to buy time before enemies start stealing gold from your hoard!

Slay your enemies in a variety of ways!

Defeat enemies by throwing them off the mountain, dropping them into lava, eating them, and more! If you're good at managing the horde of enemies, you may just find the time to shake some gold out of them before you send them off!

Defend your hoard against waves of varied foes!

From knights, to rogues, to even wizards, all kinds of enemies invade from the king's army! Block the wizard's money-thieving magic bolts, throw the rogues, and slay the knights to keep them from taking your hoard!

Feedback

If you have any feedback on the demo or just want to chat with others about the game, please join the discord through the link on the right of this page!
